Bank of America doesn't report a line called "operating income", so I used pre-tax income as the closest equivalent. For fiscal 2025 I estimate it at about $34.9 billion. This is from memory and not checked against the 10-K.

The estimate works backward from net income of roughly $30.5 billion for 2025, grossed up for an effective tax rate of about 11–12%.

If you meant a strict "operating income" line, the answer would be not_applicable for a bank.
